def mvcc.bkRecs (γ : backend.BNames) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF :=
  if r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty then mvcc.bkNoCmpF γ
  else iprop(∃ n, backend.fkFlag γ n ∗ backend.fkOpen γ n (mvcc.recsVals r))

def mvcc.recsVals (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : backend.FkVals :=
  (Option.map (fun x => mvcc.revBytes { main := x, sub := W64 0 } false) r.fin,
    Option.map (fun x => mvcc.revBytes { main := x, sub := W64 0 } false) r.sched)
